tasks.short: Help develop methods and procedures for field surveys.

steps.what: Try methods while conducting field surveys.
Provide assistance in the development of methods.
File the draft methods and procedures.

tasks.design: Trying a method while conducting field surveys stays outdoors. Assistance in the development of methods and procedures stays a conversation and a note. {DOCS} files the draft. The party chief signs a procedure outside this task. The file is not that signature.
tasks.previous_blocker: Methods were agreed in the field and written up later, if at all.
tasks.enabler_now: Filing a draft is a store. Whether the method works is not.
tasks.still_hard: A method that failed on site, or a procedure the crew will not follow, stays the trial and the note.
tasks.human_edge: The technician has used the old method and knows which step breaks.
tasks.altitude: Filing the draft takes less chasing. Trying the method and helping write it stay.

reach.task: Sign a procedure only after reading the draft
reach.learn: Which step failed in the field

evidence.claim: Storing a draft procedure is a file. Trying a method in the field is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician tries the method and files a draft. Adopting the procedure is the party chief's later decision, not a gate inside this task.
Structured input: method name, survey id, what happened. Producer is the technician. A draft with no method name is not filed.
Field trial time stays. The file does not mark the procedure adopted.
research_questions: How often is a method used before anyone writes it?

already_counted.description: Trying the method is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire drafts that were never adopted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the trial is not written, the field work is unchanged and there is no draft to file. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Answer questions on maps, boundaries and zoning.

steps.what: Hear questions from public, staff and members.
Find assessment maps, surveys and property records.
Answer regarding boundaries, easements, ownership or zoning.
Provide information on roads and similar matters.

tasks.design: Questions from the public or staff are heard by the technician. Assessment maps, surveys and property records are found when they are indexed. The answer on boundaries, easements, ownership, roads, zoning and similar matters quotes the record or says it is not there. A model does not give a boundary opinion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Answers depended on who was in the office and which map they could find.
tasks.enabler_now: Finding a stored map is a search. Saying what it means for a boundary is not.
tasks.still_hard: A question the records do not cover, or two records that disagree, stays an answer of not found or a referral.
tasks.human_edge: The technician knows when a question has become a boundary dispute.
tasks.altitude: Finding an indexed record takes less searching. Hearing the question and answering stay.

reach.task: Take questions the record does not answer

evidence.claim: A search that returns a stored map can be listed. Answering a boundary question cannot.
An answer about ownership can be relied on. The source pack does not name the land-registry rule. The answer quotes the record and is not a boundary determination.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician answers from records. Determining a boundary is a different task. The caller's identity is not stored.

Structured input: subject (map, survey, boundary, easement, ownership, road, zoning), parcel id if given. Producer is the question for the subject and the store for the record. A subject with no record is answered as not found.
The answer stays. Nothing is invented to fill a gap.
unknowns: Who takes a question the records do not answer?
research_questions: How often is the same boundary question answered differently?

already_counted.description: Answering from the record is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire search scraps that are not part of an answer.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the maps are not indexed, the search does nothing and the technician still answers from what they can find. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compare contour lines with aerial photographs.

steps.what: Open images, aerial photographs and reference materials.
Compare topographical features and contour lines.
Verify the accuracy of their identification.

tasks.design: Images from aerial photographs, old maps and other reference materials are placed beside the map. Comparing topographical features and contour lines, and verifying the accuracy of their identification, stay the technician's. A placed image does not correct a line.
tasks.previous_blocker: Photographs and maps were compared on a light table, and a mismatch was easy to skip.
tasks.enabler_now: Placing an image is a view. Seeing that a contour is wrong is not.
tasks.still_hard: A photograph that is older than the map, or a feature that could be either thing, stays a comparison.
tasks.human_edge: The technician knows which line the photograph has made doubtful.
tasks.altitude: Placing the images takes less setup. Comparing and verifying the identification stay.

reach.task: See the mismatches that were not corrected

evidence.claim: Placing a photograph on a map is a view. Verifying a feature is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician compares and verifies. Redrawing the map is a different task.
Structured input: map id, image id, feature id, mismatch note. Producer is the map and the photograph store. A mismatch with no feature id is kept as a note, not a correction.
Comparison time stays. The view does not move a contour.
unknowns: Are photographs tied to the same coordinates as the map?
Who may correct a shared contour?
research_questions: How often is a contour left wrong after the photograph was available?

already_counted.description: Comparing the features is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire mismatch notes when the map version changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the photographs are not stored, the technician still compares the prints in hand. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Operate land-information systems, inquiries, plots and reports.

steps.what: Operate and manage computer systems, storing data.
Performing tasks, making inquiries, producing plots.
Check reports before they leave the office.
Release the checked plots and reports.

tasks.design: Storing data, making inquiries and producing plots run on {DATA_PLATFORM} when the inquiry names a stored field. The technician checks a report before it leaves the office. {DOCS} releases only that checked report. A free-text question is not an inquiry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plots were made by hand from a query someone remembered.
tasks.enabler_now: A named field can be stored and plotted. Whether the report should leave cannot.
tasks.still_hard: An inquiry the store cannot answer, or a plot that looks wrong, stays a check.
tasks.human_edge: The technician knows which report the office is not ready to send.
tasks.altitude: Storing and plotting named fields takes less rebuilding. The check before a report leaves stays.

evidence.claim: Storing a row and plotting a named field are system tasks. The source pack names land-information stores that do this. Releasing a report is still a check, not a measured case here.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician operates the store and checks what leaves. Answering a public question is a different task.
Structured input: record id, field name, inquiry id. Producer is the technician for new data and the store for the inquiry. An inquiry with no field name is not run.
The check is remaining time. An empty inquiry is not filled with a nearby plot.
unknowns: Which inquiries are named fields today?
research_questions: How often is a plot rebuilt because the inquiry was typed free-hand?

already_counted.description: Checking a report is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire unreleased plots after the inquiry is closed.

approvals.approved_version: report the technician checked for that inquiry

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the inquiry is free text, nothing is plotted and the technician still checks anything that would leave. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Field methods are tried before they are written, and the draft is not a signed procedure. Public answers quote the record or say it is not there. Comparing a photograph with a contour stays visual. A plot leaves the office only after a check.
reach: The party chief signs a procedure outside this task.
A report that was not checked is not released.
skills_to_grow: Say when the record does not answer.
Do not treat a placed photograph as a correction.
role.ambitious_version: The same boundary question gets the same record, and a free-text inquiry is not plotted.
